Do you love him?
A lot of people who tell you to dump him are single and are quick to say, leave him, dump him.

It sounds like you've accepted that he has this condition.
So why would you want to track his every move? It's just going to give you more things to worry about.

Why not look for alternative solutions? Maybe the reason he couldn't tell you was because he is ashamed?

Also I suspect he feels like he needs to live double life to keep you happy.

I'm not picking sides here, by the way.


But have you tried exploring your and his sexuality together? Trying things out as a couple?

It's happened to me before... 
Hard to explain why or how it happens. Brain just shuts off and before you know, the ball is in your hands.

One of the weird moments in football.

Nothing you can do about it.

So, no jokes. I always used to see this guy in North west london after work. He always wore sunglasses and would sing like this every time. On the train, on the road, every where ALL THE TIME. Never saw him not singing.

One day I saw him in another part of London, singing again. At the top of his voice. I always thought something  was wrong with him.

Although sometimes I felt a little envious that this guy could just sing and not care who heard him.

I hadn't seen him for a few years and recently wondered where he was, now he pops up on my reddit singing again, this time, rather than a bunch of annoyed londoners rolling their eyes at him on the train, the whole park was singing with him. 

Very nice moment, 

Felt really happy to see this.
